title: react-dom 19.3.0 bump across console workspaces
summary: This change bumps the `react-dom` dependency from 18.3.1 to 19.3.0 in two workspaces — the `console-lab` app and the `console-ui` package — while leaving `react` itself pinned at 18.3.1. The lockfile follows: the old `react-dom@18.3.1` / `scheduler@0.23.2` pair is dropped and replaced by `react-dom@19.3.0` / `scheduler@0.28.0`, and every peer-resolved snapshot that depended on react-dom (react-aria, react-aria-components, @testing-library/react) is re-resolved against the new version. No source code changes; the blast radius is the dependency graph and the renderer that both workspaces share at runtime and in tests.
